Ask AbundanceAnswers to the questions we get most

Hi, we are a nurse-led NDIS provider for complex and high-intensity care in Sydney and Perth. Pick a question below, or reach us directly at the bottom.

Common questions

Capacity changes, so we answer honestly case by case. Tell us the participant's needs and we will say plainly whether we can take it and when we can start, usually within one business day.
PEG and enteral feeding, complex bowel care, catheter care, complex wound management, continence and medication support, delivered by or under the supervision of registered nurses.
Yes. We are a registered NDIS provider, Reg ID 4-JCLD6XE, holding thirteen registration groups including High Intensity Daily Personal Activities (0104) and Community Nursing Care (0114).
Greater Sydney and metropolitan Perth, including Parramatta, Blacktown, Liverpool, Campbelltown, Bankstown and Fairfield, plus the Central Coast, Newcastle and Wollongong.
Yes. Our rosters are built for active night, sleepover and 24-hour arrangements in the participant's own home, with a nurse-led escalation path after hours.
Use the referral page. Send the diagnosis, the clinical tasks and the hours. You get an instant confirmation and we reply with next steps.
Yes. We match workers to language and culture for diverse communities, including specialised African community support.

Question not listed? Reach us here
